messages:
claire.procure: Vendor K sent their pilot invoice and T&Cs. They applied a $5k pilot credit but clause says credits are "invoice-only" and can't be used to meet commit thresholds. Can finance/billing advise before I respond?

oscar.finance: paste the invoice snippet? main asks: do we want credits to offset first-year commit or at least count for tiering?

claire.procure: snippet:
```
Invoice 2026-06-01
- Ingest (GB): 3,000 @ $0.01 = $30.00
- Processing (10k): 250 @ $6.00 = $1,500.00
- Pilot credit: -$5,000.00
Net due: -$3,470.00
```
And T&C: "Pilot credits apply to billed invoices only and shall not reduce minimum committed thresholds or be transferable."

maya.sales: that's standard pushback. We should ask for conversion of credits into year-1 prepayment at least 60% if amendment signed within 30 days. That preserves our economics.

raf.billing: accounting note: if converted to prepayment, vendor will treat as deferred revenue and that affects their recognition; for us it's fine. If they insist on invoice-only credits, we need a clear credit memo and a sample billing entry for our AP and tax team.

oscar.finance: negotiation plan: request 60% conversion + a credit memo ID and an audit right to verify unused credits against pilot usage. Also ask them to remove the "not transferable" phrase or clarify it doesn't prevent conversion to our contract.

vendorbot: Vendor K uploaded terms v1.0: https://vendork.example.com/terms/2026-06-10 (doc)

claire.procure: I propose reply: 1) we'll accept pilot as-is but request amendment that converts up to 60% of unused pilot credits to year-1 commit prepayment upon signed amendment within 30 days; 2) require vendor to issue a single credit memo with conversion details; 3) insert audit right and sample invoice. Pay pilot invoice once vendor provides corrected wording or confirms in writing. Any objections?

maya.sales: no objections. I'll push rep for the amendment and timeline. If they refuse 60% ask for 50% + SLA credits.

raf.billing: once vendor confirms, send sample credit memo to me. I'll update AP workflow and tax team. If they won't provide sample, withhold disputed amount as per dispute policy.

oscar.finance: ok. tagging legal after vendor replies for amendment language. Endorse proceeding with the conditional payment approach.

claire.procure: thanks — messaging vendor now. I'll post their reply here.
